name: NetworkTroubleTicketConsole
tagline: NOC trouble tickets with live response and restore SLA clocks, incident correlation and MTTR – in one Power Platform control.
description: A complete service-assurance app for telecom operators, ISPs and network teams: dashboard, ticket queue, status board, parent incidents and SLA watch. P1–P4 severities with response and restore clocks, escalation tiers advised from SLA consumption, customer-notification cadence for mass outages, root cause and RFO before close, bulk actions, undo and a phone layout. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped, then connects to a collection, Dataverse, SharePoint or SQL table, a model-driven view or the Power Pages Web API.
features: Response and restore SLA clocks per severity with pause while pending customer
Status rules with required assignee, root cause, RFO and notes
Escalation tiers advised at 50 / 75 / 100 % of the restore SLA
Customer notification cadence for P1/P2 outages
KPIs: open, P1, breached, at risk, customers affected, MTTR, MTTA, SLA met %
Bulk acknowledge, escalate, assign, queue, link, status and CSV export
controlType: standard (2 controls: NetworkTroubleTicketConsole data-set + NetworkTroubleTicketConsolePortal field control, shared src/app)
